topic: WhatsApp Business integration — how client requests flow into a tracked case instead of a group chat
format: Walk through a feature in 4-5 steps: what triggers it, what it does, what it prevents, who saves time
post:
A client sends a WhatsApp message at 9pm: "We need to renew three work permits — urgent."

By morning, it's buried under 47 other messages. Nobody followed up. The deadline passes.

SmartPRO Hub's WhatsApp Business integration was built specifically for this moment.

Here's how it works:

A client message comes in through WhatsApp. SmartPRO Hub automatically converts it into a tracked case — assigned, timestamped, and visible to the right team member. No copy-pasting. No forwarding. No "I thought you were handling it."

The client gets a reference number. The team sees a status. The manager sees a dashboard.

What it prevents: requests disappearing into group chats, duplicate replies from two people, and the classic "we never received that" conversation nobody wants to have with a client.

Who saves time: PRO service firms, Sanad offices, and HR teams managing high-volume document requests across multiple clients or entities.

Our customers using PRO services automation in Oman tell us this one feature alone justifies the switch from spreadsheets and WhatsApp threads.

Structure doesn't slow things down. It's the only reason things actually get done.
